tests_recommended: Chest X-Ray (PA view), Sputum Gram Stain & Culture, Complete Blood Count (CBC), Pulse Oximetry (SpO2)
treatment: Empiric antibiotic therapy (e.g., Amoxicillin-Clavulanate or Azithromycin), bronchodilator nebulization, supplemental O2 if SpO2 < 92%, adequate hydration.
prevention: Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV13/PPSV23), annual influenza immunization, smoking cessation, respiratory hygiene.

tests_recommended: Rapid Influenza Diagnostic Test (RIDT) or RT-PCR Nasopharyngeal Swab, Vital Signs Monitoring
treatment: Neuraminidase inhibitors (Oseltamivir/Tamiflu) if within 48h of onset, Antipyretics (Paracetamol), warm fluid hydration, bed rest.
prevention: Quadrivalent annual influenza vaccination, hand hygiene, avoiding close contact during outbreaks.

tests_recommended: Urgent Lumbar Puncture for CSF Analysis (opening pressure, protein, glucose, cell count), Blood Cultures, Cranial CT scan
treatment: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY CODE: Stat IV broad-spectrum antibiotics (Ceftriaxone + Vancomycin) + IV Dexamethasone prior to/with first dose, ICU admission.
prevention: Meningococcal conjugate vaccine (MenACWY/MenB), Hib vaccine, chemoprophylaxis (Rifampin) for close contacts.

tests_recommended: Clinical assessment; rapid strep antigen test if sore throat is severe to rule out GABHS pharyngitis
treatment: Symptomatic relief: Saline nasal irrigation, oral decongestants/antihistamines, zinc lozenges, hydration and rest.
prevention: Frequent hand sanitation, avoiding touching eyes/nose/mouth, isolating while actively symptomatic.

tests_recommended: Dengue NS1 Antigen ELISA (Days 1-5), Dengue IgM/IgG antibody test, Serial CBC for Platelet Count & Hematocrit
treatment: Close hemodynamic & platelet monitoring, Oral/IV isotonic fluid replacement, Paracetamol for pyrexia. CONTRAINDICATED: Aspirin/NSAIDs (severe hemorrhage risk).
prevention: Vector control: eliminate stagnant water breeding sites, DEET mosquito repellents, permethrin-treated bed netting.

tests_recommended: Fasting Plasma Glucose (FPG), Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio (uACR), Serum Lipid Panel
treatment: Lifestyle intervention (low-glycemic Mediterranean diet, aerobic exercise), First-line Metformin therapy, SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 agonists as indicated.
prevention: Weight management, routine diabetes screening for adults >= 35, balanced nutrition, physical activity > 150 min/week.

tests_recommended: Serum Electrolytes (BUN, Creatinine, Na+, K+), Stool Routine Examination & Culture, Stool viral PCR if outbreak suspected
treatment: Aggressive Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS), IV Ringer's Lactate if severely dehydrated, Antiemetics (Ondansetron), probiotic supplementation.
prevention: Strict food and water hygiene, hand washing with soap, Rotavirus immunization in infants.

tests_recommended: Spirometry / Peak Expiratory Flow, Chest Radiograph to exclude pneumonia, SpO2 monitoring
treatment: Inhaled short-acting beta-2 agonists (Albuterol/Salbutamol), warm humidified inhalation, antitussives, avoidance of irritants.
prevention: Avoid exposure to cigarette smoke and industrial fumes, wear N95 particulate respirators in dusty environments.

tests_recommended: STAT 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG within 10 minutes), High-Sensitivity Cardiac Troponin I/T (serial at 0h, 1h, 3h), Echocardiogram
treatment: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY PROTOCOL: STAT Chewable Aspirin 300mg + Clopidogrel 300mg, Sublingual Nitroglycerin, Supplemental O2, Activate Cardiac Cath Lab for Emergency Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI).
prevention: Cardioprotective Mediterranean diet, strict blood pressure control (<130/80), statin therapy, smoking cessation, routine lipid screening.

tests_recommended: Skin Prick Testing (SPT) for environmental allergens, Serum Allergen-Specific IgE (ImmunoCAP assay)
treatment: Intranasal corticosteroid spray (Fluticasone/Mometasone) daily, second-generation non-sedating oral antihistamines (Cetirizine/Loratadine), nasal saline flush.
prevention: HEPA air purifiers, keeping windows closed during peak pollen counts, allergen-impermeable bedding covers.

tests_recommended: Rheumatoid Factor (RF), Anti-Cyclic Citrullinated Peptide (Anti-CCP), Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR), C-Reactive Protein (CRP), Joint X-rays/Ultrasound
treatment: Early consultation with a rheumatologist, Disease-Modifying Antirheumatic Drugs (DMARDs - Methotrexate), NSAIDs for acute inflammation, physical rehabilitation.
prevention: Early diagnosis prevents permanent joint erosions, maintaining low-impact physical exercise (swimming/cycling), smoking avoidance.

tests_recommended: Complete Blood Count (CBC - Low Hb, MCV < 80 fL), Serum Ferritin, Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC), Transferrin Saturation, Fecal Occult Blood Test (FOBT) to rule out GI blood loss
treatment: Oral elemental ferrous sulfate/ferrous fumarate (100-200 mg/day) with Vitamin C to enhance absorption; IV iron (Ferric Carboxymaltose) if intolerant or severe.
prevention: Iron-dense nutritional diet (lean meats, spinach, legumes, fortified cereals), screening adolescent females and pregnant individuals.
